theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_mcr_threshold_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Λ c : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ws : ℕ → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → μs j K ≠ ∞) → (∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall 0 2 → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * μ (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall 0 2 → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * μs j (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))) → Tendsto ws atTop (𝓝 w) → ‖w‖ < 2 → (∀ j, c ≤ (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μs j (ball (ws j) ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal) → c ≤ (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball w ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal
